name: codex-mail-bridge
description: Find and reference locally signed-in Thunderbird or classic Outlook mail, including Office 2019. Retrieve relevant messages and original files for GPT through a local skill and CLI.

interface.longDescription:
Mail Bridge lets GPT find and reference email from Thunderbird or classic Outlook already signed in on this computer, including Office 2019. Sign in and sync needed mail before use; keep classic Outlook running in that profile.

This local desktop plugin uses a skill and one-shot CLI commands. Python 3.10+ and host command/file access are required; the optional launcher uses Node.js. Outlook needs Windows PowerShell 5.1 under its existing policy. No remote service, MCP server, login credentials or API key is required by the bridge.

Choose one account explicitly. Search by date/time, subject, body, sender, recipient or folder. Small metadata pages are the default; GPT can continue broader searches, read body sections and conversations, and retrieve selected original attachments or inline images. GPT and the host's file tools interpret documents; the bridge does no PDF/Office parsing, OCR or attachment execution.

Originals default to 10 MiB each; callers can allow up to 100 MiB when needed. Up to 16 files remain in private local export storage. Unexpired files are preserved when full. Release finished files explicitly; later exports or cleanup remove copies older than 10 minutes. No background cleanup runs.

Mailbox access is read-only: no sending, saving drafts, deleting, moving, marking read, forced sync or policy changes. Local indexes/caches may be stale or incomplete. New/web/Mac Outlook, shared delivery stores and extra archive stores are unsupported. Live Outlook provider attachment export and installed-host integration remain unverified.

Retrieved account details, mail and files opened by the AI host can reach OpenAI for the requested task. Local execution does not make GPT offline. There is no Cyp Soft backend, telemetry or mail archive. Independent Cyp Soft project; not affiliated with Mozilla, Microsoft or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose one Thunderbird account and check its local mail index.
Find recent emails about a project in my selected Thunderbird account.
Find a requested attachment by subject and date, then hand off only that original file.
